facts.fact: Luisa 当初为离 Giovanni 近才和演员梦的 Adamaria 合租
facts.anchor: She was happy because she would be close to her boyfriend

facts.fact: Giovanni 到达时发现 Luisa 的门被砸烂只挂在上合页上
facts.anchor: Someone has smashed in Luisa’s door

facts.fact: 进门先袭来海腥气味，如九月风暴潮的海滩
facts.anchor: The first thing that strikes him is the salty smell, intense as the beach during September storm surges

facts.fact: 公寓消失成无尽海洋，门开向悬崖
facts.anchor: The apartment has vanished. No more tiled floors, no more Tori Amos posters on the walls, no more anything. Instead, there’s the ocean—endless water

facts.fact: 崖边一个艳色装束的海盗持刀推搡一个被缚蒙眼的少女入海
facts.anchor: At the edge is a man dressed as a pirate, in garish colours, with a sabre in hand

facts.fact: Giovanni 判定是幻觉：右有岛、左有船，船与 Augusto 家的 Galleon 雕塑同款
facts.anchor: This is a hallucination. On the right there’s an island of luxurious vegetation. On the left a ship identical to that of Thomas More or (and?) of Captain Hook—and to the Galleon sculpture at Uncle Augusto’s house

facts.fact: 少女被海盗一脚踢落海，Giovanni 停止思考冲上去
facts.anchor: Giovanni thinks, the pirate doesn’t. He launches a kick at the young woman, who falls with a splash

facts.fact: 空手打人让他想起疼痛与活着的实感
facts.anchor: It’s been years since he’s hit anyone barehanded, he forgot how much it hurts. And how alive it makes him feel

facts.fact: 拳击教练 Guido 的告诫在他脑内指导格斗
facts.anchor: Never take your feet off the ground, Guido repeats in Giovanni’s head

facts.fact: Giovanni 朝悬崖跑时现实似为他让步
facts.anchor: Reality seems to concede to him

facts.fact: 四步之内幻景褪回公寓：瓷砖、墙、城市气味
facts.anchor: At the first step tiles replace the ocean, at the second walls rise around him, at the third the smell of the sea shifts into that of the city

facts.fact: Adamaria 湿透溺死在与海与魔法都无关的城里公寓
facts.anchor: the body is soaking wet, water in her hair, water in her clothes, water draining from her mouth. In this urban condo, as far from the sea as from every illusion of magic, the young woman has drowned

facts.fact: Wendy 对 Dal Mare 出现在丧宅的厌恶反应
facts.anchor: Bloody hell, out of everyone who could have shown up …

facts.fact: Dal Mare 眼中闪过极快的认光（认出 Wendy 曾在公园监视）
facts.anchor: A glint of recognition flashes through his eyes, so rapid that a less attentive observer wouldn’t have seen it

facts.fact: Dal Mare 对 Giada 说的表面好话，实际是布局
facts.anchor: Stay close to Angela

facts.fact: 邻居电话告知 Wendy 家被入室
facts.anchor: I’ve been burgled

facts.fact: 被毁的 Occult Casket 值三十欧但问题不在钱
facts.anchor: the Wondrous Wendy does not consider herself a venal woman

facts.fact: 入室的核心伤害：家被侵入=自我被侵犯
facts.anchor: The point is that Angela feels violated

facts.fact: 外部世界（Dal Mare 与 Aldo 们统治之处）闯进了她的避难所
facts.anchor: The outer world, the place where people like Augusto Dal Mare and Aldo Miglio hold sway, has burst into her refuge

facts.fact: 叙述者标注 Wendy 的顿悟时刻：变的不是某事，是她的整个人生
facts.anchor: This is a crucial moment for the Wondrous Wendy

facts.fact: Giovanni 电话告知：Adamaria 溺死，衣物湿透，不是幻觉
facts.anchor: Adamaria’s drowned

facts.fact: Giovanni 电话里说：他看见的岛让他想到 Neverland
facts.anchor: The island I saw made me think of Neverland

facts.fact: Dal Mare 亲吻 Michele 额头后突然把他摔下床
facts.anchor: Then he grabs him by the shoulder and throws him out of bed

facts.fact: 被打的 Giada 第一次知道真实的暴力不是书本概念
facts.anchor: real violence plunges her into true terror. It isn’t like in books. Here the blows hurt

facts.fact: 手杖柄在 Giada 眼前变成钩
facts.anchor: Only now it isn’t a handle, it’s sharp and pointed—it’s a hook

facts.fact: Dal Mare 对 Silvia 宣告行凶时的自称
facts.anchor: I’m killing you,” says Captain Hook

facts.fact: 钩动时世界溶为热带海滩与森林——Giada 看见两个世界叠合
facts.anchor: while the hook moves, the world dissolves. A beach and a verdant forest appear

facts.fact: 杀死 Silvia 后 Dal Mare 转向审问 Giada 的语气反差
facts.anchor: Now let us talk of Peter Pan

facts.fact: Dal Mare 的威胁修辞，被屋顶的 Twin 心里骂作谎话精
facts.anchor: My mercy is infinite, young lady, Peter’s is not

facts.fact: Giada 的求生推理：不为宠物萨满送命，供出 Peter 在家
facts.anchor: Heroes stand firm against villains. Why should I?

facts.fact: Dal Mare 对 Stefano 尸体说话：你没看懂你卷入的故事一半
facts.anchor: You didn’t understand even half the story you found yourself in

facts.fact: 他对死者宣布：你的神不会重返人间
facts.anchor: Your god will not return to earth, not now or ever

facts.fact: 名句：你治愈疯子，错在自己也加入了他们
facts.anchor: You healed the mad, Stefano: your mistake was joining them

facts.fact: 四岁红发孩子 Weirdo 传话：赤脚女士 Tinker Bell 派他来
facts.anchor: Tinker Bell sent me, you know, the lady with no shoes on at the uniperticy

facts.fact: Weirdo 恳求快点：否则这次行动又不带上他
facts.anchor: Hurry,” he begs. “Or they’ll leave me out this time too

facts.fact: 烧退的 Michele 醒来发现床漂在海面
facts.anchor: Michele no longer felt the heaviness of the fever, he was just a little weak, that’s all

facts.fact: 叙述者的定义：萨满用的就是人人所有的「注视与理解」之力
facts.anchor: He, a shaman, does what anyone can do, uses the power that each human possesses, that of watching and understanding

facts.fact: 海滩上是 Mama 被剖开的遗体，孩子们围成半圆替她合眼、收拢内脏
facts.anchor: It has been gutted, the intestines hanging out. It’s surrounded by a huddle of children arranged in a semicircle

facts.fact: 而 Silvia 本人（灵魂）活着站在旁边，尚未知情
facts.anchor: Watching the scene there’s also Silvia, alive

facts.fact: Giovanni 与孩子互不可见，两边都看得见 Michele
facts.anchor: they live in different worlds. But both can see Michele

facts.fact: Michele 以萨满的知觉完成推理：能同时看见三方的人只有他
facts.anchor: Mama is dead

facts.fact: Michele 对母亲灵魂说的送别语
facts.anchor: Go where you need to go, where Papa is. Here you’re done

facts.fact: 灵魂离去只此一下；剩下的是提线木偶般的躯壳
facts.anchor: Silvia goes away, that’s all, and afterwards Silvia isn’t there—there’s a body, there’s a puppet, a soft soulless machine

facts.fact: bear-ears 孩子告知凶手在现实世界的名字
facts.anchor: Where you come from,” says the one with the bear ears, “he’s called Augusto Dal Mare

facts.fact: 章末句：男孩就这样变成男人
facts.anchor: And that’s how the boy becomes a man, learning what cruelty is, learning what hatred is, with nobody left to protect him from the world
